summary: Neither z/OS nor z/OS UNIX System Services can be an Ansible control node. On IBM Z you can use z/OS Container Extensions, Red Hat OpenShift on IBM zSystems and LinuxONE, or Linux on IBM Z.
questions: Can I run Ansible on the mainframe itself as the control node?
What options exist for a control node on IBM Z?
Can z/OS USS be the Ansible control node since it's POSIX?

answer_card.title: Control node options on IBM Z
answer_card.answer_md:
z/OS, and z/OS UNIX System Services despite being POSIX-compliant, can't run as an Ansible control node. On IBM Z you can use:
- IBM z/OS Container Extensions (zCX)
- Red Hat OpenShift on IBM zSystems and LinuxONE
- Linux on IBM Z
